attempted_claim: Let (M,J) be a closed aspherical complex surface of general type. Is it true that χ(M) ≥ 3τ(M) ≥ 0, with τ(M)=0 if and only if M is a quotient of H^2×H^2 (with the product metric)?
decisive_failure: No proof or disproof of the target was obtained. The signature-sign half (tau >= 0) coincides with a published open problem (Albanese-Di Cerbo-Lombardi) and the tau = 0 rigidity half requires a bidisk tensor hypothesis not implied by asphericity (Catanese-Franciosi, Moishezon-Teicher). Known families were surveyed for consistency only; no new example, invariant, or theorem was produced.
